name: Chatizy – Floating Chat Widget with Contact Form, Multi-Agent & Campaign Targeting
author: schorpy

sections.description:
Chatizy is a modern and lightweight WhatsApp chat plugin for WordPress, designed to improve customer engagement, lead generation, and marketing performance. Add a floating WhatsApp chat button to your website, assign multiple chat agents, run campaign-based targeting, and capture leads with a built-in Contact Us form (Pro).

Built for marketers, businesses, agencies, and freelancers who want to connect with visitors instantly via WhatsApp or through a simple lead capture form.

Track every interaction — Chatizy records incoming clicks, captures leads, and provides detailed insights including browser, device type, and operating system. Perfect for optimizing campaigns and measuring what works.

🎯 Features

  • WhatsApp Chat Button
    Add a customizable floating WhatsApp chat button to your website.

  • Chat Agents
    Assign multiple chat agents with names, photos, working hours, and WhatsApp numbers.

  • Campaign Targeting
    Display different chat widgets based on pages, posts, categories, or custom rules.

  • Contact Us Form (pro)
    Built-in form that sends inquiries directly to your email or WhatsApp.

  • Click Tracking & Lead Reporting
    Automatically track incoming clicks on agents as leads. View reports including browser, device type, and operating system to better understand your visitors.

  • Dark Mode Support
    Chatizy automatically adapts to dark themes or lets you enable dark styling manually.

  • Submission List (Pro)
    View and manage all Contact Us form submissions inside your WordPress dashboard.

  • Conversion Tracking (Pro)
    Track which chat agents and campaigns are driving the most conversions and leads.

  • Mobile Responsive
    Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design.
sections.faq:
How do I add the WhatsApp chat button to my website?

After installing and activating Chatizy, go to the plugin settings in your WordPress dashboard. From there, you can enable the floating chat button and customize its appearance.

Can I assign multiple agents to the chat button?

Yes! Chatizy lets you add multiple agents with names, photos, and WhatsApp numbers. You can display them in rotation or based on your campaign rules.

Can I target the chat button to specific pages or posts

Absolutely. With Chatizy’s campaign targeting feature, you can show different chat buttons based on page URLs, post types, categories, or custom rules.

Can I customize the design of the chat button?

Yes, you can change the button text, icon, color, position, and more—all from the plugin settings.

Does Chatizy include a Contact Us form? (Pro feature)

Yes. The Pro version of Chatizy includes a built-in Contact Us form that allows visitors to send messages directly to your email or WhatsApp number. It’s perfect for capturing leads even when you’re offline or unavailable on chat.
